name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Solutions Engineering & Technical Pre-Sales | B2B SaaS
summary: Technical sales and solutions professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, translating complex software into solutions that technical and non-technical buyers both understand. At Accelo, scoped CRM/PSA solutions for agencies and professional-services firms, built sequenced implementation plans, and guided API integrations as a trusted advisor to C-suite clients, ranking top three in sales while quota doubled. Designs CRM, automation, and LLM-based agent systems hands-on (APIs, SQL, Python and JavaScript code steps), and routes structured customer feedback into product roadmaps.

experience.title: Solutions Design & Automation (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Run discovery with business owners to surface goals and operational problems, then design and scope the CRM and automation solution, writing proposals and SOWs.
Architected a 20+ workflow GoHighLevel system with SMS and email covering lead routing, qualification, booking, reminders, onboarding, and reactivation.
Integrate client CRMs and sites through Zapier, Make, and n8n, writing Python and JavaScript in custom code steps and SQL against BigQuery and Power BI data models.
Design LLM-based agent workflows and translate non-technical stakeholders' ideas into precise prompts, agent logic, and technical configurations.
Lead onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into configurations and training client teams hands-on.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Presented strategy and performance to multi-stakeholder client teams, translating data into recommendations and QBRs.
Coordinated execution across internal departments as strategic lead for integrated digital programs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing-automation software.
Onboarded and trained 15-20 reseller partners, equipping them to communicate product value to their own customers, and retained all but one (~94% retention).
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (~$130K+ total) and led the sales team.
Pursued a major northeastern U.S. banking prospect through to finalist stage.

bullets: Carried a combined sales and implementation load, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while launching 25+ clients per month.
Developed sales training for tenured account executives and trained new hires as team lead of onboarding specialists (20, later 8).
Defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture.

experience.title: Account Executive (Technical Pre-Sales & Implementation Planning)
bullets: Sold and scoped Accelo's CRM and project-management platform to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in pipeline automation and workflow configuration.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, advising C-suite executives on operational system design.
Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled, closing deals of $20K and larger.
Built Zapier automations and tracked customer issues through Zendesk.
